title: Minimum Sum of Four Digit Number After Splitting Digits
goal: Split four digits into two numbers with the smallest possible sum.
strategy: Each digit contributes either a tens or units place. Put the two smallest digits in the tens positions and the two larger digits in units positions; leading zeros are allowed.

phasePurposes.start: Split four digits into two numbers with the smallest possible sum.
